baseline_models.mechanism: The coordinated fa-sequence moves from cry, to forceful bodily impact, to articulated speech. Her body therefore presents an argument before her two nominal predicates state it.

activation_trace.role: The extended cry or outcry supplies the audible onset of the reaction and makes the صرة an event rather than a neutral location.
Forceful collision and striking turn the cry into bodily impact, the middle stage of the counterutterance.
The face as the struck site makes her own visible front the surface on which disbelief is enacted.
Overtly voiced speech converts the preceding sound and gesture into the explicit claim عجوز عقيم.

changed_reading.before: She reacts emotionally and then says that she is old and barren.
changed_reading.after: Cry, impact, face, and speech form one escalating counterutterance: her body argues the impossibility before her words name it.

baseline_models.mechanism: A forward-facing entrance is crossed by a self-description located at age, rearwardness, and reproductive closure. The verse stages contradiction as motion toward a future that the speaker's body-model declares already behind her.

activation_trace.role: Advance and coming forward provide the prospective vector with which the terminal predicates collide.
The face and exposed front keep the reaction oriented toward what is arriving rather than away from it.
Old age supplies the direct temporal evidence by which she treats future generation as implausible.
The rear or aftermath image spatializes her self-placement at the far end of a life-course.
Reproductive barrenness closes the future that the forward motion has just opened.

changed_reading.before: Her approach merely introduces an elderly infertile speaker.
changed_reading.after: Her body moves forward while her labels place possibility at the rear and seal it; the ayah performs the temporal contradiction rather than only reporting it.

baseline_models.mechanism: The approach-root can activate willing reception, while the barrenness branch defines a womb that does not receive offspring. The woman simultaneously enters as a receiver of news and names herself as a site incapable of reception.

activation_trace.role: Acceptance with inward assent supplies the live possibility that her physical approach is also an act of receiving.
The woman as relational human subject locates the reception crisis in a person, not in an abstract fertility category.
A womb or person that does not accept offspring supplies the blocked receptive channel opposed to acceptance.

changed_reading.before: She comes in and reports infertility.
changed_reading.after: Her coming is a paradox of reception: she receives the announcement while insisting that the bodily site meant to receive its outcome cannot do so.

baseline_models.mechanism: Several remote but packet-licensed focus branches unexpectedly assemble a delivery scene around the denial of fertility: receiving a newborn, a hands-first birth, and a child arriving to aged parents. The ordinary gesture sequence and the latent birth sequence coexist without turning either into the literal gloss of the other.

activation_trace.role: The birth attendant receiving what emerges supplies a delivery-threshold image beneath her approach.
A hands-first birth makes the hand-to-face gesture unexpectedly echo bodily emergence.
The last child born when parents are old supplies the precise age-versus-birth paradox latent in عجوز.
Explicit reproductive barrenness resists and thereby sharpens the cluster of delivery images.

changed_reading.before: The verse contains a gesture followed by two reasons that childbirth is impossible.
changed_reading.after: Even while denying childbirth, the focus roots quietly stage receiving, emergence, and a late-born child, so impossibility and delivery imagery occupy the same instant.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding scene repeatedly tests reception: strangers enter, offered food is not taken, fear follows, and news of a boy arrives. Her approach and claim that offspring cannot be received become the climax of a house-wide sequence in which entry, acceptance, and incorporation repeatedly fail or change form.

activation_trace.role: Literal entry establishes the household threshold and begins the repeated question of what can come inside.
Eating as incorporation is explicitly solicited but withheld, furnishing a social analogue for failed reception.
News that should open the visible countenance introduces a promised reversal of fear and nonacceptance.
The youth of the announced boy is the generative content that must cross the final, bodily threshold.
Acceptance turns her approach into the decisive human reception point of the sequence.
The nonreceiving womb concentrates the earlier threshold failures into the biological objection.

structural_cues: The packet orders entry, greeting, food presentation, refusal to eat, fear, boy-news, and only then the woman's approach.
The focus repeats the same fa-driven rapidity that carried the meal and announcement through the house.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies entered guests, uneaten food, boy-news, and a woman who approaches while naming infertility; I infer a shared reception/incorporation mechanism. A live alternative is that these are only successive hospitality actions with no designed analogy to the womb.

changed_reading.before: Her infertility is a private objection to unexpected news.
changed_reading.after: Her objection is the last and deepest threshold in a staged reception crisis: guests enter, food is not incorporated, news arrives, and the promised child meets a body imagined as unable to receive.

context_deltas.mechanism: A context branch of nearness specifically includes approaching birth, and it is followed by glad news of a young boy. Those cues activate the focus's otherwise remote branches for a birth receiver, hands-first emergence, and the late child of aged parents.

activation_trace.role: Nearing birth converts the meal's physical bringing-near into an exploratory delivery threshold.
Joy-opening news supplies the explicit announcement that calls the latent delivery branches into activity.
The young boy gives the delivery cluster a concrete promised outcome.
Receiving a newborn positions her approach at the imagined endpoint of delivery.
Hands-first emergence lets the striking hand participate in the latent birth choreography.
A child arriving in the parents' old age directly binds the announcement to her age predicate.
Barrenness keeps the delivery model paradoxical rather than allowing it to become an easy literal reading.

structural_cues: The bringing-near of food is immediately followed by the boy announcement and then the woman's hand-to-face approach.
The latent birth images cluster across consecutive ayat rather than depending on a remote thematic association.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a قرب branch for nearing birth, explicit boy-news, and focus branches for receiving and difficult emergence; I infer that narrative adjacency activates a delivery script. The live alternative is that قرب remains solely the serving of food and the focus branches are accidental polysemy.

changed_reading.before: The birth-related focus branches are isolated lexical curiosities.
changed_reading.after: The nearby-birth branch and explicit boy-news make them a coherent, still exploratory delivery choreography embedded inside her denial.

context_deltas.mechanism: Her terse predicates operate as a verdict grounded in age and barrenness, but the next ayah answers with repeated speech and attributes of completion, growth, exact ordering, and disclosed knowledge. The sequence changes her words from final ontology into evidence presented within an unequal contest of claims.

activation_trace.role: Her overt utterance frames عجوز عقيم as a spoken claim that can receive an answer.
Old age supplies the first observed premise of her verdict.
Barrenness supplies the second observed premise and the apparent closure of the claim.
Repeated voiced speech makes the next ayah a direct counterutterance rather than detached narration.
Repair, nurture, and bringing to completion supply a causal capacity opposed to her closed body-model.
The non-dominant mapped branch of feeding and growth keeps actual generation, not mere verbal reassurance, active in the reply.
Exact making and secure ordering oppose the idea that the promised outcome is an incoherent accident.
Knowledge as disclosure supplies an epistemic horizon larger than the evidence visible in her body.

structural_cues: Her verbless pair عجوز عقيم is followed immediately by قالوا كذلك قال ربك.
The answer closes with الحكيم العليم, explicitly shifting the basis on which possibility is judged.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a claim, an immediate counter-speech attributed to her Lord, and branches of completion, growth, ordering, and knowledge; I infer an authority and evidence reversal. A live alternative is that the reply only reassures and does not demote her predicates as a mode of knowing.

changed_reading.before: Old age and barrenness are settled facts that make the announcement unintelligible.
changed_reading.after: They remain true observations but cease to function as a final verdict; the next speech relocates causal competence and knowledge beyond her embodied premises.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus names her relationally and raises the future of one marriage, while the later sequence extracts believers, finds no household except one, and leaves a sign. The promised birth can therefore be read as household futurity placed at the edge of a scene where other households are removed and reduced to an enduring trace.

activation_trace.role: The woman identified through marriage makes generation a question about the continuity of a relational household.
Barrenness names the apparent impossibility of that household carrying life forward.
Extraction from concealment supplies the selective preservation operation on the threatened settlement.
Exclusion and 'no other' narrow the social field to a single surviving unit.
The household and its dependents make collective continuity, not architecture alone, the unit that remains.
Leaving an effect behind supplies the negative counterpart to a family that may leave living posterity.
The visible sign is the residue of judgment, contrasting with the promised child as a living continuation.

structural_cues: The birth exchange is immediately followed by the messengers' destructive commission and the count of one surviving house.
The pericope places a promised descendant and a settlement reduced to a sign on opposite sides of the same pivot.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a wife facing infertility, extraction of believers, exactly one household, and a remaining sign; I infer a contrast between living household futurity and residual memorial trace. The live alternative is that the birth scene and the settlement count are adjacent missions without this household-level mirroring.

changed_reading.before: The woman's reaction concerns only her individual capacity to bear a child.
changed_reading.after: Her reaction stands at a household-continuity threshold: one union is promised a living future just before another social world is reduced to one extracted house and a sign.

context_deltas.mechanism: The direct reproductive sense of عقيم coexists with branches for a nonfertilizing destructive wind and annihilating conflict. The following mission sends materially composed, marked harm toward those who exceed limits, allowing her private predicate to act as a semantic hinge between impossible generation and a judgment process that produces no future.

activation_trace.role: Reproductive barrenness supplies the direct self-description from which the cross-domain hinge turns.
A wind that neither fertilizes nor carries rain but destroys extends nonproduction into an ecological mode of judgment.
An annihilating conflict supplies the social and lethal edge of the same branch field.
Sending and launching supply the directed movement of the judgment material.
Hard stone gives the destructive process a bounded material carrier.
Mixed clay supplies formed earthly matter, sharply opposed to the living formation promised in the birth scene.
A visible identifying mark makes the harm selected rather than indiscriminate.
The split mapped branch of imposing harm adds the directed punitive function carried by the mark.
Exceeding a limit supplies the selection criterion for the destructive stream.

structural_cues: The sequence pivots directly from a promised boy and the word عقيم to the messengers' commission against a criminal people.
Life-producing promise and marked death-bearing matter are adjacent, opposed outcomes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies destructive branches inside the focus root and then a directed marked-stone mission; I infer a shared nonproduction-to-destruction function. A materially live alternative is that only reproductive barrenness is active in the focus and the punitive branches remain unrelated polysemy.

changed_reading.before: عقيم is only a private medical or reproductive predicate.
changed_reading.after: It can also serve, exploratorily, as the pericope's hinge: generation is opened for one household while a barren, future-ending process is directed toward another community.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the surface verb is ordinary 'said,' yet the packet's non-dominant mapped target supplies bodily trembling. It remains anchored by the licensed split root and the adjacent cry and collision; downstream prose should render it as an affective-acoustic undertone, not as a replacement morphology or dictionary translation.

activation_trace.role: The cry supplies audible pressure already destabilizing calm speech.
Forceful collision gives the utterance a bodily jolt.
Canonical voiced speech preserves the ordinary syntactic reading.
The split branch of trembling from fear or anger colors the speech as a bodily vibration without displacing قول.

changed_reading.before: Her statement is a stable proposition following an emotional gesture.
changed_reading.after: The proposition itself still carries the cry and blow as tremor; saying is the final vibration of the bodily event.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The written-document branch of صك makes this a deliberately cross-domain reading. It remains anchored in the actual face-strike, spoken claim, and later packet cues of marking and leaving a sign; downstream prose should call it an inscription analogy, never claim that she literally writes or that صكت means 'documented' here.

activation_trace.role: The written instrument turns the blow, analogically, into an act of certifying her objection.
The visible face supplies the public surface on which that bodily certification appears.
Spoken words provide the content certified by the gesture: old and barren.
A visible identifying mark activates the notion that consequential states are made legible on a surface.
The enduring visible sign scales private bodily legibility into a public residue of the whole event.

changed_reading.before: The face-slap is only an involuntary sign of shock.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, she stamps her face as the visible warrant for her spoken impossibility, anticipating the pericope's marked matter and remaining sign.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This material analogy is surprising because it uses the rare chaff-grain barrier branch of عقم with knotting and door-closure branches. It remains anchored in three focus roots and gains functional support from the later extraction and exclusion sequence; downstream prose should qualify it as a sorting-threshold model, not a lexical gloss of the woman's infertility.

activation_trace.role: Tying and knotting supply the first image of a channel compressed shut.
A door slammed closed turns her gesture into a threshold refusing passage.
The barrier separating straw from grain supplies an explicit sorting function inside the barrenness root.
Selective extraction supplies the passage of one class through the larger judgment threshold.
Exclusion and exception complete the sorting mechanism by defining what does not pass.

changed_reading.before: Her compressed gesture expresses a reproductive blockage.
changed_reading.after: The blockage can also miniaturize the pericope's sorting threshold: closure, separation, selective extraction, and exclusion gather around the instant when divergent futures are announced.

strongest_changes: The bodily sequence is one counterutterance, not a gesture followed by unrelated speech.
The preceding hospitality scene turns her infertility into the deepest instance of a repeated reception and incorporation problem.
Context activates a hidden delivery lexicon already distributed across the focus roots while preserving its exploratory status.
The immediate answer revises old age and barrenness from final verdicts into embodied evidence answered from a different causal and epistemic position.
The later extraction of one household allows promised posterity and judgment's remaining sign to coexist as opposed forms of what survives.
summary.what_was_special: The focus inventory itself contains unusually precise counter-images to the woman's denial: receiving a newborn, hands-first birth, and a child of aged parents. Context does not settle these into one interpretation; it strengthens reception, delivery, household-continuity, and destructive-hinge readings at once, while split mapped roots preserve tremulous speech and growth as live secondary activations.
remaining_uncertainties: The delivery choreography may be meaningful latent convergence or accidental branch density.
The reception chain depends on treating entry, eating, announcement, and gestation as functionally analogous thresholds.
The destructive, inscription, and winnowing models are visibly anchored but remain branch-distant and should not displace the direct reproductive and affective readings.
Household futurity is inferred from narrative adjacency; the packet also permits the birth and judgment episodes to remain parallel without direct causal mirroring.
